leadin: Answer the following about the American Revolution.

parts.question: This 1775 battle near Boston saw the famous order 'Don't fire until you see the whites of their eyes.' For 10 points, name this battle.
parts.answer: Battle of Bunker Hill (accept Breed's Hill)

parts.question: This Prussian general trained Continental Army troops at Valley Forge during the winter of 1777-78. For 10 points, name this general.
parts.answer: Baron von Steuben (Friedrich Wilhelm von Steuben)

parts.question: This 1781 battle effectively ended the Revolutionary War when Cornwallis surrendered to Washington. For 10 points, name this battle.
parts.answer: Battle of Yorktown (accept Siege of Yorktown)
